title: Ahotoso a Wɔde Hyehyɛ Asubɔnten no nsa
intro: Ná ɔkra bi hyia ahyɛde bi a entumi nyɛ yiye, baabi a na abofra a wɔawo no foforo nkwa sɛn nsenia no mu. Wɔde ɔsoro honhom kyerɛɛ wɔn kwan no, wodii ahyɛde bi a ɛyɛ hu so, na wɔde ahintasɛm bi a ɛsom bo too nsu a ɛreworo so no so, na wɔsan de bae wɔ ɔkwan a na wontumi nhu so.
clues: Na mete otirimɔdenfo bi a ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wonkum mmarima a wɔawo wɔn foforo no sunsuma ase.
Ɔsoro nhyɛsoɔ bi baa me nkyɛn, kyerɛɛ me sɛ menyɛ adeyɛ a ɛyɛ abasamtu na ɛyɛ awerɛhoɔ.
Mede me akokoaa a ɔsom bo no guu adaka bi mu na mede sii asubɔnten a ɛsen no so.
M’akoma mu yɛɛ hunu, na ɛkaa kakraa bi na meyii ahintasɛm no adi, nanso Allah hyɛɛ me bo a wasi no mu den.
Mesomaa obi sɛ ɔnkɔdi abofra no akwantuo a ɛrekɔ fam no akyi berɛ a nsuo a ɛreworo so no de koko no kɔeɛ no.
Otirimɔdenfo no fiefo na wohuu abofra no, na awiei koraa no, me ne me ba no san boom na mebɛyɛɛ ayarehwɛfo.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
